design: adversarial leakage/quality audit of the pooled ironflow bulk panel, with optional Track B modeled boundary-breach labels
data: research_state/data_cache/ironflow_bulk/{candles_1h,funding,open_interest,liquidations}, 18 months 2025-05..2026-10, .parquet.sha256 asserted before every read, caches read-only
context: FCLR-POOLED-001 (session_20261122T092003Z) returned NOT_SUPPORTED: funding-conditioned features add no QLIKE improvement over RV-only baseline (rel ~0.0%, below -2.0% materiality floor). audit_domains: d1_future_row_perturbation: future-row perturbation must not change earlier features/forecasts (row-order monotonicity, cross-file timestamp overlap)
d2_split_embargo: split embargo integrity (purge >= max horizon) on the pooled chronological train/test boundary
d3_funding_sign_timing: funding sign/timing - publication vs settlement handling
d4_mark_index_alignment: mark/index alignment under frozen tolerance (1% mark-oracle premium)
d5_missingness_preservation: no zero-fill/forward-fill; nulls preserved as-is
d6_delisting_symbol_migration: delisting/symbol-migration identity (coins entering/exiting the universe, market-coin mapping stability)
d8_stress_concentration: market stress concentration (one coin/crisis driving the result)
d9_threshold_drift: funding tercile threshold drift across months
d10_overlapping_outcomes: overlapping outcomes across forward horizons (6h/24h/72h/168h liquidation-intensity labels)
trackb_modeled_boundary_breach: optional Track B modeled boundary-breach labels from mark-price history + public margin params, labeled as modeled proxy, never observed liquidation

splits.boundary: single cut between train_end and test_start; no purge/embargo rows dropped by this audit (gap reported, not assumed)

decision_rules: descriptive audit only; no pass/fail threshold-shopping; findings reported as measured, nulls preserved as NOT_SUPPORTED where applicable
software: stdlib + pyarrow only; numpy/pandas/scipy not used; no network; no new source
independent_recompute: fclr_pooled_audit001_recompute_20261122T165200Z.py (strict exact-timestamp alignment, daily RV stress, positive-only liquidation median, 5% breach band)
